title: SARdine: browser-native SAR data inspection and exploration
description: SARdine (SAR Data INspection and Exploration) is a browser-native tool for inspecting and exporting synthetic aperture radar (SAR) data. It streams NISAR Level-2 GCOV and GUNW HDF5 products and Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs in place via chunked HTTP range requests, using a pure-JavaScript HDF5 chunk reader (h5chunk). Radiometric scaling, contrast stretching and polarimetric composites are computed on the GPU (WebGL2/WebGPU), and georeferenced GeoTIFFs and figures are exported client-side with machine-readable provenance sidecars. No server, GDAL or Python is required.
